metric_definitions.arithmetic: Decimal precision 60, lossless money, ratios half-even to six places; serialized float stops use Decimal(str(value))
metric_definitions.bridge_limit: accounting identity at actual sizes/exits; reference quote is not a simulated alternative fill or an attainable profit claim
metric_definitions.entry_shortfall: confirmed quantity * (actual entry price - original decision ask); positive is an adverse price difference
metric_definitions.initial_risk: confirmed entry shares * (recorded entry price - recorded initial stop); not guaranteed maximum loss
metric_definitions.population: all 12 alternative paths and all 30 dates; never pool horizons/accounts into independent observations
metric_definitions.price_bridge: reference-to-actual-exit price component minus entry shortfall minus all fees equals actual net P&L
metric_definitions.reason_attribution: sum realized sell P&L by recorded reason; exit fees shown separately; entry fees remain a separate debit
metric_definitions.reentry: second confirmed entry for the same activation in a path; aggregate whole episodes including all fees
metric_definitions.scope: post-result diagnostic; baseline losses already known; no threshold or policy change
metric_definitions.sizing: requested/filled/cancelled shares, notional and initial stop risk relative to that session's opening equity
metric_definitions.stage_attribution: mutually exclusive profit-target, first terminal, second residual, third-or-later continuation orders; includes unfilled orders
metric_definitions.stop_shortfall: for initial_stop sells only: quantity * (initial stop - actual sell); signed difference, not a causal effect of waiting
metric_definitions.unfilled_or_blocked: retain all original decisions; no hypothetical P&L or lost-profit estimate
metric_definitions.waiting: orthogonal annotation from original wait_submitted evidence; never added to reason/stage totals
